name: Thumbmix
subtitle: An iPhone remote for the Midas M32

apps.name: Thumbmix
apps.subtitle: An iPhone remote for the Midas M32
apps.localizedDescription: An open-source remote for the Midas M32, built for thumbs: horizontal fader rows you drag anywhere, every common action at most two taps deep.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Thumbmix talks to your M32 over the local network.

versions.localizedDescription: • Screenshots in SideStore
• The Key line says whether the key filter is on
• An edit queued before an outage never reaches the desk after it
• Names for mute groups
• Open a preset file from AirDrop, Mail or Messages
• A swipe down no longer closes the edit sheet
• Native segmented control for the group and tab bars
• A preset load closes onto the strip

• Folder and file preset sources

• Preset sources on the web, with the repo's presets as the default

• Reset gate, Reset comp and Reset input
• Shake the phone to share this run's log

• The EQ curve no longer jumps for a frame while a band moves

• Dashed lines stay put while the threshold moves
• Drop the ±1 dB buttons on the Mix tab

• Assign and unassign a DCA's strips on its Members tab

• An on/off chip waits disabled and dimmed until the desk sends its value

• SOLO on the Mix tab and S beside the slim fader on every other tab

• The compressor knee visibly bends the curve
